static_traits.name: 刘欣怡
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends，但尚not yet与他们讨论此具体问题；因频繁取消清晨活动与朋友关系受影响
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往类似心理问题或心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、合作，情绪基调中性；能具体描述trigger情境与感受；存在以“会毁掉整个周末”等灾难化和非黑即白用语；能接受建议并进行具体计划；not yet见思维紊乱迹象。

basic_info.main_problem: 在周末需要早起时感到极度痛苦和Anxiety，认为这会毁掉整个周末，从而回避一切涉及周末清晨的计划。
basic_info.core_demands: 周末早起相关的痛苦与Anxiety已影响心理健康与周末的整体享受，希望通过咨询缓解Anxiety、改变“早起=毁掉周末”的看法并恢复对周末的享受。
growth_experiences: 几个月前因一次压力很大的摄影活动需要在周末清晨起床，强烈的压力体验后开始对周末早起产生Significant anxiety，逐渐发展为回避所有涉及清晨的计划，导致人际受损与睡眠模式被打乱。

core_beliefs: 我without法很好地应对早起带来的疲惫与not适
一旦周末出现not理想的环节，整体就会被毁掉

special_situations.event: On Sunday mornings, needs to get up early for photography activities or handle affairs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I need to get up early on the weekend, I will be tired and irritable all day and the whole weekend will be ruined
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免安排任何涉及周末清晨的计划；尝试放松与分散注意来降低Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 一旦周末早起，这个周末就完了。

special_situations.event: A friend proposes a weekend activity invitation requiring early-morning gathering
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果睡眠not够，我就without法享受活动，状态会很差并持续到整个周末
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前取消计划、Avoids socializing邀请以避免早起
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: From the moment I get up this morning my state will be poor, and the whole weekend is ruined.

special_situations.event: Going to bed the night before the weekend and thinking about getting up early the next day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要not睡好，第二天和整个周末都会一团糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces herself to relax and uses distraction methods to try hard to fall asleep
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果现在cannot sleep，明天就毁了，周末也毁了。

special_situations.event: 回顾以往与早起相关的经历
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有完全轻松的周末才算好周末
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on fatigue and negative cues, ignoring possible positive experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我从not因为早起而有过好的体验。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to have relaxation and a sense of control on weekends, to enjoy rest and social activities calmly
core_conflict.fear: 害怕早起导致持续的疲惫与Emotional loss of control，从而破坏整个周末并影响Interpersonal relationships
defense_goal: Maintains controllability and safety by avoiding any arrangements involving weekend mornings
Justifying cancellation and avoidance with the belief that 'getting up early = ruining the weekend'

object_relations.self_representation: 我容易被疲劳压垮，需要Self-protection的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Friends' invitations are experienced as others bringing pressure and demands

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends or others propose plans requiring early weekend-morning gatherings, or when the session focuses on the 'weekend early rising' topic
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将“早起的not适”等同于“整个周末被毁”，把外界邀约体验为对自我界限与掌控的威胁
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declines or cancels in a polite but firm tone, emphasizing rational reasons such as 'need rest / worried it will affect my state', avoiding further exploration of emotional experience.

manifestations: 强烈希望自主安排周末的节奏与睡眠，将早起视为对Freedom与休息的剥夺（如活动邀约、工作安排）
以回避来维持对周末的掌控
outcomes: 周末体验缩减与Decreased quality of life

manifestations: Reduces contact with friends due to frequently canceling early-morning activities
not yet向朋友透露具体困扰

positive_force: Has a supportive circle of friends
Willing to try new coping strategies (such as behavioral experiments and written records)
Has planning and preparation ability (plans routes in advance, organizes equipment, arranges breakfast)
职业功能稳定（工作not yet受影响）
Interest in and engagement with photography can be converted into positive motivation to get up early
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking（早起=毁掉整个周末）
预测not yet来与过度概括，夸大疲劳后果
对早起的回避行为导致Reduced socializing
睡眠相关Anxiety引发作息紊乱
对困扰保持沉默，not yet主动寻求朋友支持

target_behavior.behavior: 回避涉及周末清晨的活动与计划
antecedent: 临近周末时想到需要早起
Receives early-morning gathering invitations/tasks from friends or event organizers
周末前一晚担心睡not好或without法恢复精神
target_behavior.core_reason: 几个月前高压摄影活动的not良体验与认知偏差（灾难化、非黑即白、预测not yet来）Reinforcement了“早起会毁掉周末”的信念与Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的not适与Anxiety，维持对周末的可控感
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends、周末体验下降、Disrupted sleep patterns、周末相关Anxiety持续存在
